name: duel-casino
caption: Wildcard against Arsonists in the casino: Garrison, the Pit Boss, deals Smokestack a losing hand.
alt: A match in the casino between a Wildcard deck and an Arsonists deck, both boards full: playing cards fly from Garrison, the Pit Boss, toward Smokestack.

name: duel-turn
caption: Every turn starts with the Deployment Phase: call in fighters, play Hustles, set Ambushes.
alt: A Militia against Underworld match in a military base, with the words DEPLOYMENT PHASE across the board.

name: duel-brawl
caption: Pirates against Militia on the docks: Hellstorm loses the brawl to Dreadmaw and goes Down.
alt: A match on the docks: a Militia character turned on its side under a DOWNED stamp after an attack by a Pirates Heavy.

name: duel-ko
caption: Hit a fighter while it's Down and it's KO'd: the Herald of the Hollow Throne finishes Catherine.
alt: A match in a graveyard: a Wildcard character bursts into playing cards under a K.O. stamp after an Underworld attack.

name: duel-ambush
caption: AMBUSH! A Militia attack runs into the Arsonists' Inferno Wall.
alt: A match in a volcanic arena: the word AMBUSH! over a face-down Arsonists card turning up as the Militia attacks.

name: awaken
caption: Captain Marlow AWAKENS: when the moment comes, a leader takes the street himself.
alt: A Pirates leader card in a burst of rays under the words CAPTAIN MARLOW AWAKENS.

name: legendary
caption: A Legendary takes the street: Iron Lieutenant Kessler drops in for the Militia.
alt: A Militia card in a burst of golden rays under the words LEGENDARY · IRON LIEUTENANT KESSLER.

name: inferno
caption: Inferno Shockwave: the whole Nebula line catches fire at once.
alt: An Arsonists Hustle sets every Nebula character on the board burning, with Cinder, the Arsonists' leader, on the field.

name: turf-boss
caption: Turf Defense: you and a partner against Veyr, the Hollow King, and his army of the dead.
alt: The entrance of a Turf Defense boss: Veyr, the Hollow King, Sovereign of the Dead, with his card and his first line.

name: promote
caption: Lyra Quell promotes mid-attack: level 1 to level 2, stronger on the spot.
alt: A Nebula card in a burst of light under the word EVOLVED, two stars lit, with its new level, ATK and DEF underneath.

name: pack
caption: A Legendary from an Arsonists pack: Pyra, the Undying Flame.
alt: A card in a shower of gold under the word LEGENDARY!, just turned over after opening an Arsonists booster pack.

name: stasis
caption: Hull Breach: a Nebula Ambush locks the whole Underworld line in STASIS.
alt: On a frozen board, rings of light lock each Underworld character in STASIS after a Nebula Ambush springs.

name: ffa
caption: Free-for-all: four players, one board.
alt: A four-player match, each player with a corner of the board.

name: victory
caption: Victory, and the match's most valuable card.
alt: The Victory screen after a match, with the match numbers and the most valuable card.

name: main-menu
caption: The main menu.
alt: The main menu in neon signs: Fight, Deck Editor, Shop, Auction House, Card Library, Achievements, Turf Map and the daily quests.

name: deck-builder
caption: The deck builder.
alt: The deck builder: the card collection on the left, the deck and its leader on the right.

name: turf-zoom
caption: The Frozen Lake and The Lab, up close on the turf map.
alt: The turf map zoomed in on two districts: a frozen lake and a glowing green laboratory.

name: card-library
caption: The Card Library: every card, and how many you own.
alt: A grid of cards in the Card Library.

name: turf-map
caption: The turf map: every district of the city, and who holds it this week.
alt: A painted map of the city at night with a clan emblem over each district.

name: fight-mode
caption: Five ways to play.
alt: The battle mode screen: Casual Brawl, Ranked Brawl, VS CPU, Free-for-all and Turf Defense.

name: rank-up
caption: Ranking up to Underboss.
alt: The words RANK UP over the Underboss emblem.

name: district
caption: A district: who holds it, and who is fighting for it.
alt: A district's panel on the turf map: the clan that holds it and each clan's influence there this week.
